candidate_sentence_map.S1: AS Tallinna Sadam reported a decline in profitability during the first six months of 2026, despite a modest increase in revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: The Group generated revenue of EUR 59.3 million, representing a 2.4% increase compared to EUR 57.9 million in the same period of the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: This growth was primarily driven by higher charter fees from the multifunctional icebreaker Botnica, increased revenue from the sale of electricity, and a rise in ferry service sales.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: However, these gains were insufficient to offset a significant surge in operating expenses, which rose by 24.0% to EUR 20.2 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: The increase in costs was largely attributable to higher fuel prices, which pushed fuel expenses up by 47.6%, as well as increased electricity costs and higher expenditures on technical maintenance and repairs.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Additionally, depreciation, amortization, and impairment charges grew by 6.0%, reflecting new infrastructure projects and scheduled vessel maintenance.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Consequently, operating profit decreased by 25.7% to EUR 13.6 million, down from EUR 18.3 million in the prior year period.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The operating profit margin contracted from 31.6% to 22.9%.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Adjusted EBITDA also declined, falling by 13.5% to EUR 25.8 million from EUR 29.8 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The profit for the period was significantly impacted by the absence of one-off gains that had boosted the comparative period, specifically a EUR 0.9 million profit from the disposal of land for the Rail Baltica project and an insurance indemnity received for repair works on the icebreaker Botnica.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: As a result, net profit for the six-month period dropped by 41.7% to EUR 6.0 million, with earnings per share decreasing to EUR 0.02 from EUR 0.04.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Operational volumes reflected a challenging market environment.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Total cargo handled decreased by 5.0% to 6.5 million tonnes, driven by a sharp 33.8% drop in liquid bulk volumes.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Passenger numbers fell by 2.0% to 3.6 million, although cruise passenger traffic surged by 47.8% due to an increase in cruise ship calls.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: The number of vessel calls declined by 4.8%.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: In the second quarter, the negative trends continued, with profit for the period falling by 59.0% to EUR 1.4 million, partly due to the lack of the aforementioned one-off items from the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: On the balance sheet, total assets decreased slightly by 1.1% to EUR 615.0 million, while equity declined by 0.3% to EUR 367.7 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Net debt increased by 1.5% to EUR 145.8 million, although total loans and borrowings decreased by 5.7% to EUR 173.4 million due to principal repayments.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: The company maintained its dividend policy, paying EUR 19.2 million in dividends for the 2025 financial year.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Looking forward, the Group faces risks from global economic instability and rising energy costs, which continue to pressure operating margins.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: The company also secured a new EUR 32 million loan facility to support general business purposes and ongoing investments.
